column1: # How a PRX_Component value no components.csv row names is placed. Read top to bottom and the first rule whose Words all appear in the value wins.
# Words: whole words the value must hold in any order. Case and spacing do not matter and a per cent sign is ignored.
# Template: the workbook the value fills.
# Folder: a fixed folder name or the word value. value is the value tidied: one space between words and STRT read as STREET and LESS 20m read as LESS THAN 20m.
# Main: the folder the Grouped layout puts Folder under. A fixed name or the word base or left empty.
# base is the value with its MORE THAN 60% or LESS THAN 60% part removed so FRIDAY MOSQUE MORE THAN 60% groups under FRIDAY MOSQUE.
# Main left empty files one level in both layouts: Output then Folder then the plot's UID2.
# Flat files Output then Folder then UID2. Grouped files Output then Main then Folder then UID2.
